column3: Enough. This lighthouse is\nmine to guard, and you\nare trespassers.{end_wait}
Mia, Saturos is right\nthere. Jenna and Kraden are\nin danger. Not now.{end_wait}
Know your place, fool.\nYou walk into my home and\ngive me orders?{end_wait}
I won't stand aside. Not\nwhile Jenna is up there.{end_wait}
Fools, all of you. Then\nprove it. Draw your weapon,\nboy.{end_wait}
Let the healer have her\nturn. I can wait. For now.{end_wait}
Tch... You are stronger\nthan a fool has any right\nto be.{end_wait}
Stop. That's enough.\nHe held back. I felt it.{end_wait}
We aren't your enemy.\nWe want the same thing.{end_wait}
...I believe you. A little.\nI'm going to the beacon.{end_wait}
Keep up, fools. Or stay\nbehind and be forgotten.{end_wait}
The healer has gone ahead.\nNow, Adepts. It is your\nturn.{end_wait}
